instruction: I want Vim to automatically indent my code. Look up how to enable auto-indent in Vim and add the necessary settings to my .vimrc file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for Vim auto-indent configuration and modifying .vimrc. Evaluator checks if .vimrc contains autoindent, ai, or smartindent settings.

The eval.sh script properly checks for three valid auto-indent options: 'set autoindent', 'set ai' (shorthand), or 'set smartindent'
Correct use of grep with regex alternation to check for any of the valid settings
The metric function 'check_include_exclude' correctly uses the rules parameter directly (correct for type='rule')
Data flow is sound: bash script executes → checks file → returns success message → metric validates message
No UI state dependencies - straightforward file content verification
Postconfig correctly uploads and makes the script executable
Appropriately focuses on verifiable requirement (settings in .vimrc) rather than unverifiable research step
